Data notes

  • No earlier weekly report has been uploaded for this project. The previous-week figure (56.9%) and this week's gain (20.2%) come from the 26-Oct report's own "Previous week Effort" column. A gain of 20.2% in one week is unusually large: the monthly S-curve data shows 27.6% in September and 77.1% in October. Please confirm.
  • The weekly report gives 05-Oct-2026 as the forecast completion with 0 days of variance, although the data date is 26-Oct-2026. The P6 update schedules 26-Nov-2026.
  • Site handover is 06-May-2026 in the weekly report but 07-Jul-2026 in the P6 update. The week number (24) counts from 06-May-2026.
  • The P6 update records actual start or finish dates after its 26-Oct-2026 data date for 107 activities (up to 24-Nov-2026), so its progress status is not reliable.
  • Activity counts differ: the weekly report shows 195 completed, 123 in progress and 236 not started; the P6 update shows 309, 137 and 108.
  • The P6 print-out labels a cost-based progress figure as "Actual %". This report uses physical (man-hour) progress only.
  • The "Two Week Look Ahead" print-out covers 28-Sep to 05-Oct-2026, before the data date.
  • Several sheets hold another project's data: Major Quantities (sewer, storm and water items dated 2024), the lower table of the Milestones sheet (SUD1-05-015) and Sheet1 (KUMT-05-001). The Procurement sheet's P6 activity column shows KHJ1-05010. The scope quantities section is therefore left out.
  • The Procurement sheet marks 156 of 166 items as delivered, with no quantities delivered, while P6 shows most procurement activities still in progress. The procurement section is left out until the two agree.
  • The invoice log header shows a revised contract value of 21,100,000 SAR, an estimate at completion of 20,900,000 SAR and potential changes of 200,000 SAR; all other sheets show 15,898,659.13 SAR and 0. Invoice 4's net amount incl. VAT repeats invoice 3's (2,864,258.52 SAR).
  • Labour by trade totals 50 in the Weekly Progress Report sheet and 109 in the Manpower sheet.
  • The Weekly Progress Report sheet shows MIRs and FIRs shifted by one column (57 / 7 and 420 / 65); the Quality-Stat sheet gives 64 issued, 57 closed, 7 pending and 485, 420, 65.
  • Cumulative man-hours are 42,166 but safe man-hours 42,116, although no incident is recorded. The safety score is 0.85 in the summary and 0.88 for the consultant's 24-Oct inspection.
  • The DB sheet shows #REF! for the project scope and for several key dates.
